run_dexmachina_mpc: run DIAL MPC with Genesis DexMachina backend using hydra configuration and receding horizon control loop
setup_dexmachina_env: setup the Genesis DexMachina simulation environment with built-in reference data and object parameters
create_mpc_optimizer: create a rollout-based MPC optimizer using make_rollout_fn, make_optimize_once_fn, and make_optimize_fn
step_simulation_env: step the DexMachina environment forward with control inputs and collect object distance metrics
sync_env_state: synchronize the DexMachina environment state across parallel samples after each control step
